# ACP Meeting Notes

Meeting notes and information from meetings carried about by ACP group members

# Transports WG

Meeting notes from the Transports Working Group.

The Transports WG discusses the ACP over HTTP transport specification, covering protocol design, SDK implementations, and resilience strategies. Check the [Zulip channel](https://agentclientprotocol.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/543475-core-maintainers) for details.

# Core Maintainers

Meeting notes from the Core Maintainers team.

The Core Maintainer group meets at 07:00 PST / 16:00 CET every other Thursday. Check the [Zulip channel](https://agentclientprotocol.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/543475-core-maintainers) for details.
